title: Organisations protest against pesticide deregulation outside European Parliament

tea.why: Protesters opposed the European Commission's Omnibus X proposal, arguing it weakens pesticide safeguards and risks public health.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded that Members of the European Parliament reject the legislative package on pesticides.
tea.changed: Nov 24: Hundreds of organizations demonstrated outside the European Parliament in Strasbourg against pesticide deregulation.

summary: On November 24, 2026, a demonstration took place in front of the European Parliament in Strasbourg, organized by over 300 European organizations including environmental NGOs, health protection groups, farmers, beekeepers, doctors, scientists, and patient associations. The protesters gathered to voice their opposition to the European Commission's Omnibus X legislative package, which aims to simplify food and feed safety rules by introducing unlimited authorizations for certain low-risk pesticides and extending post-ban tolerance periods. Participants and researchers warned that removing periodic re-evaluations would expose populations to dangerous chemical substances and threaten public health and the environment. Meanwhile, the European Commission defended the legislative proposal, stating it would reduce bureaucracy and save over a billion euros annually for companies and national administrations, while some officials argued that existing authorization procedures are excessively long compared to other sectors.
demands: Reject the Omnibus X legislative package
Maintain periodic re-evaluations of chemical substances
Protect public health and environmental safeguards against harmful pesticides
response: The European Commission stated that the legislative package will remove bureaucratic blockages and generate savings of over one billion euros annually for companies and national administrations.

updates.text: Over 300 organisations demonstrated in front of the European Parliament in Strasbourg against the Omnibus X pesticide proposal.
